chapter: Dance and brass bands of Alice's youth
title: Dance bands Alice heard as a girl
summary: She describes string bands with violin, accordion, bass, flute, piccolo and cornet, but no drums in her day.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: I wonder what kind of music did they have? Did you ever go to any dances when you were young, a little girl even? Did you hear any of the dance music when you were even a child? Oh, yes. We used to… What was the music like? What kind of an orchestra did they have or band? Most of the string band.
Mm-hmm. But most of the… Like… Accordion. Accordion. Accordion. Accordion. Accordion. Mm-hmm. And bass. And bass.
Bass violins, yeah. Did they have any drums or triangles or anything like that?
I don't remember they had drums when I was going out.
Anything like George's clarinet or a flute or anything like that?
Well, they'd have flutes, yes. And they'd have violin and they'd have bass. Piccolos.
And horn, well, they'd have cornet.
Would they have slide trombones in those days or valve trombones?
I never noticed that, but I know they'd have cornet.
